story.text: 그날 이후, 하늘의 방은 평소와 조금 달라졌다. 침대 옆 휴대폰 화면이, 꺼질 새 없이 계속 켜져 있었다.
story.reading: geu-nal i-hu, ha-neul-ui bang-eun pyeong-so-wa jo-geum dal-la-jyeoss-da. chim-dae yeop hyu-dae-pon hwa-myeon-i, kkeo-jil sae eobs-i gye-sok kyeo-jyeo iss-eoss-da.
story.en: After that day, Haneul's room looked a little different than usual. The phone screen by his bed barely had a moment to go dark.

story.text: 이름을 몰라서 검색조차 쉽지 않았다. 그런데도 그는 늦은 밤까지 기사와 영상들을 하나씩 눌러보고 있었다.
story.reading: i-reum-eul mol-la-seo geom-saeg-jo-cha swip-ji anh-ass-da. geu-reon-de-do geu-neun neuj-eun bam-kka-ji gi-sa-wa yeong-sang-deul-eul ha-na-ssig nul-leo-bo-go iss-eoss-da.
story.en: Not even knowing her name made searching hard. And yet, deep into the night, he kept clicking through articles and videos, one after another.

story.text: 동기 조종사가 옆에서 놀렸다. '야, 너 그거 여전히 보고 있냐?' 하늘은 화면을 서둘러 끄며 대답했다. '…아니야, 그냥 뉴스 보는 거야.'
story.reading: dong-gi jo-jong-sa-ga yeop-e-seo nol-lyeoss-da. 'ya, neo geu-geo yeo-jeon-hi bo-go it-nya?' ha-neul-eun hwa-myeon-eul seo-dul-leo kkeu-myeo dae-dab-haess-da. '…a-ni-ya, geu-nyang nyu-seu bo-neun geo-ya.'
story.en: A fellow pilot teased him from the seat next to him. 'Hey, are you still watching that?' Haneul quickly shut the screen off. '...No, I'm just reading the news.'

story.text: 마음이 복잡했다. 그저 얼굴 하나에 이끌렸던 감정이, 이제는 다른 무게로 다가왔다. 손님이면서, 동시에 수만 명이 좋아하는 사람이라는 사실이.
story.reading: ma-eum-i bok-jap-haess-da. geu-jeo eol-gul ha-na-e i-kkeul-lyeoss-deon gam-jeong-i, i-je-neun da-reun mu-ge-ro da-ga-wass-da. son-nim-i-myeon-seo, dong-si-e su-man myeong-i jo-a-ha-neun sa-ram-i-ra-neun sa-sil-i.
story.en: His mind was complicated. A feeling that had started with just one face now carried a different weight altogether — the fact that she was a passenger, and at the same time, someone tens of thousands of people adored.

story.text: 다음 비행에서 마주쳤을 때, 그는 평소보다 말이 없었다. '…왜 그래요?' 묻는 말에 그는 겨우 대답했다. '그냥, 좀 신경 쓰여서요.'
story.reading: da-eum bi-haeng-e-seo ma-ju-chyeoss-eul ttae, geu-neun pyeong-so-bo-da mal-i eobs-eoss-da. '…wae geu-rae-yo?' mut-neun mal-e geu-neun gyeo-u dae-dab-haess-da. 'geu-nyang, jom sin-gyeong sseu-yeo-seo-yo.'
story.en: When their paths crossed on the next flight, he was quieter than usual. '...What's wrong?' she asked. He finally answered. 'It's nothing. I'm just — a little bothered, that's all.'

story.text: 늘 흔들림 없던 그의 태도가 처음으로 살짝 무너졌다. 완벽하게 정돈되어 있던 평정심에, 아주 작은 금 하나가 생긴 것 같았다.
story.reading: neul heun-deul-lim eobs-deon geu-ui tae-do-ga cheo-eum-eu-ro sal-jjak mu-neo-jyeoss-da. wan-byeog-ha-ge jeong-don-doe-eo iss-deon pyeong-jeong-sim-e, a-ju jag-eun geum ha-na-ga saeng-gin geot gat-ass-da.
story.en: For the first time, his usually unshaken composure cracked, just a little. It felt as though a tiny fracture had appeared in the perfectly ordered calm he always kept.

story.text: 유명한 사람이든 아니든, 상관없다고 생각하려 했다. 그런데도 자꾸 검색창을 열게 되는 자신이, 하늘은 낯설었다.
story.reading: yu-myeong-han sa-ram-i-deun a-ni-deun, sang-gwan-eobs-da-go saeng-gag-ha-ryeo haess-da. geu-reon-de-do ja-kku geom-saeg-chang-eul yeol-ge doe-neun ja-sin-i, ha-neul-eun nach-seol-eoss-da.
story.en: He tried telling himself it didn't matter, famous or not. And yet, catching himself opening that search bar again and again — even to Haneul, that felt like someone else entirely.

words.example_en: My mind was so complicated I couldn't sleep.
He searched about her all night.

words.meaning: To be on one's mind / bothered by
words.example_en: That comment kept nagging at him.
His composure cracked for the first time.
He was still looking at the screen.

sentences.en: His mind was so complicated he fell silent.
He spent all night searching for someone whose name he didn't even know.
That remark kept nagging at him.
His composure cracked for the first time.

sentences.ko: 그는 여전히 화면에서 눈을 못 뗐다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun yeo-jeon-hi hwa-myeon-e-seo nun-eul mot ttaet-da
sentences.en: He still couldn't take his eyes off the screen.
